abilities.name: cute-charm
abilities.effect: Has a 30% chance of infatuating attacking Pokémon on contact.

abilities.name: competitive
abilities.effect: Raises Special Attack by two stages upon having any stat lowered.

abilities.name: friend-guard
abilities.effect: Decreases all direct damage taken by friendly Pokémon to 0.75×.

kanto.flavorText: When its huge eyes waver, it sings a mysteriously soothing melody that lulls its enemies to sleep.

original-johto.flavorText: It rolls its cute eyes as it sings a soothing lullaby. Its gentle song puts anyone who hears it to sleep.

hoenn.flavorText: Nothing can avoid falling asleep hearing a JIGGLYPUFF’s song. The sound waves of its singing voice match the brain waves of someone in a deep sleep.

original-sinnoh.flavorText: When it wavers its big, round eyes, it begins singing a lullaby that makes everyone drowsy.

extended-sinnoh.flavorText: When it wavers its big, round eyes, it begins singing a lullaby that makes everyone drowsy.

updated-johto.flavorText: Looking into its cute, round eyes causes it to sing a relaxing melody, inducing its enemies to sleep.

original-unova.flavorText: When it wavers its big, round eyes, it begins singing a lullaby that makes everyone drowsy.

updated-unova.flavorText: Looking into its cute, round eyes makes it start singing a song so pleasant listeners can’t help but fall asleep.

kalos.flavorText: If it inflates to sing a lullaby, it can perform longer and cause sure drowsiness in its audience.

updated-hoenn.flavorText: When this Pokémon sings, it never pauses to breathe. If it is in a battle against an opponent that does not easily fall asleep, Jigglypuff cannot breathe, endangering its life.

original-alola.flavorText: Jigglypuff possess a vocal range that exceeds 12 octaves, but each individual’s singing skill depends on its own effort.

updated-alola.flavorText: The songs they sing are totally different depending on the region they live in. Some even sound like they’re shouting!

letsgo-kanto.flavorText: Uses its cute round eyes to enrapture its foe. It then sings a pleasing melody that lulls the foe to sleep.

swsh.flavorText: By freely changing the wavelength of its voice, Jigglypuff sings a mysterious melody sure to make any listener sleepy.
